title: Delivery Optimization: download mode HTTP only (no peering)
description: Sets the documented group policy value DODownloadMode to 0 (HTTP only, no peering) under HKLM Software Policies Microsoft Windows DeliveryOptimization: updates are still downloaded, but the machine neither uploads to nor downloads from other PCs on the internet. The previous value and its type are captured in a snapshot before the change and restored by per-feature undo.
